title: Primitive Stair Pavilion
teaches: Build a complete architectural staircase from reusable typed PrimitiveAsset geometry and first-class PBR MaterialAsset resources.
Reuse one beveled visual box and its unchanged simple collider across eleven deterministic stone-textured steps.
Combine box, sphere, plane, cylinder, cone and wedge assets in one PBR scene.
Use exact primitive dimensions to align stair rises, stringers, posts and handrails.
Light primitive architecture with shadows, ambient occlusion and ACES color management.
Drive Character 1 up all eleven steps with alternating weight-bearing plateaus and eased rises synchronized to an in-place Walk_Loop.
Keep animated toes clear of primitive risers with a small authored sole clearance instead of floating the root along one continuous slope.
Use Texture_Stone.jpg as a lit base-color surface with per-instance UV variation instead of a screen-space overlay.
Reuse 1K base-color and foliage assets plus 512-pixel normal, packed metallic-roughness and AO maps so each material texture is decoded only once.
Turn project-owned generated source textures into distinct courtyard, plaster, brushed-metal, glass-roughness and weathered architectural PBR surfaces.
Replace sphere shrubs and solid foliage blocks with shared alpha-masked leaf clusters varied by compound layout, seed, rotation, scale and tint.
Construct practical lamps from metal collars, translucent globes and aligned emissive cores, then add non-colliding drains, joints, clamps, welds and canopy trim.
Extend the collider-owning upper landing and continue the Walk_Loop root path through frame 240 so the final overview contains real forward travel instead of in-place stepping.
Blend a Radiance HDR environment with warm direct light and simplified 3D courtyard architecture before ACES finishing.

Cut one continuous stair walk between first-person, third-person and front-facing close cameras without rotating or duplicating the character, then restore the original full-courtyard overview at frame 180.
Use Camera3D.hiddenBones to hide only the owner's head in first person while restoring the complete model in later shots.
